text: logs/ holds app-*.log files from one service. Each request id (req-NNNN) has a "start" line and should end with a "done" line, possibly in a different file, in any order. A request is stuck when it has an ERROR line and no "done" line anywhere. Write the stuck request ids, one per line, sorted, to out/stuck.txt.

args.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re, glob, os
errs, dones = set(), set()
for f in glob.glob('logs/*.log'):
    for line in open(f):
        m = re.search(r'ERROR.*?(req-\d+)', line)
        if m: errs.add(m.group(1))
        d = re.search(r'\bdone (req-\d+)', line)
        if d: dones.add(d.group(1))
stuck = sorted(errs - dones)
os.makedirs('out', exist_ok=True)
open('out/stuck.txt','w').write('\n'.join(stuck) + ('\n' if stuck else ''))
print(len(stuck), 'stuck:', stuck)
EOF
cat out/stuck.txt

for r in $(cat out/stuck.txt); do
  e=$(grep -l "$r" logs/*.log | xargs grep -h ERROR 2>/dev/null | grep -c "$r")
  d=$(grep -h "done $r" logs/*.log | wc -l)
  s=$(grep -h "start $r" logs/*.log | wc -l)
  [ "$e" -eq 0 -o "$d" -gt 0 ] && echo "SUSPECT $r err=$e done=$d start=$s"
done; echo "verify done"; sort -c out/stuck.txt && echo "sorted ok"
